content: ONNX Runtime threading pitfalls: Setting intra_op_num_threads explicitly disables thread affinity, causing cache miss performance degradation. Oversubscription past physical cores wastes resources via context switching. ORT_SEQUENTIAL is default - switching to ORT_PARALLEL hurts models without many branches. Inter-op threads are useless unless parallel execution mode enabled. Spinning behavior consumes extra CPU/power. On NUMA systems, cross-node threading causes ~20% performance penalty.
